name: Morphing Switch
description: Small toggle switch whose round knob stretches, recoils and settles with an elastic path morph when clicked, and swells slightly on hover. Track color changes with state.

Clicks are ignored while the animation runs or before GSAP has loaded
Calls onChange with the new checked state when the animation completes
